summary: FibroBiologics, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an increase in its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The company previously entered into a Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co. on May 1, 2026, allowing sales of common stock under an effective shelf registration statement. On May 5, 2026, it filed a prospectus supplement raising the maximum aggregate offering price to $7.5 million. As of the filing, only 71,830 shares had been sold. No fixed price, premium, or consideration structure applies; this is a routine capital-raising activity, not a special situation. The filing also includes legal opinions on share validity.
